title: Quantum eMotion Completes C$32 Million ($22.5 Million USD) Acquisition of Cybersecurity Provider Plurilock Security - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Quantum eMotion (QNC) closed its ~C$32M ($22.5M) cash-and-stock acquisition of Canadian cybersecurity firm Plurilock Security, combining QNC's quantum entropy/PQC portfolio with Plurilock's enterprise and public-sector security operations and channels across Canada, the US and NATO.

insights.claim: Quantum eMotion Corp. (NYSE American: QNC) closed its acquisition of Plurilock Security Inc. (TSXV: PLUR) in a cash-and-stock deal valued at about C$31.98 million ($22.5 million USD), buying all 114,231,441 shares for C$0.084 cash plus 0.0763 QNC share each, an implied C$0.28 per share.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Stock component dilutes QNC holders; PLUR shareholders now hold QNC exposure — watch post-close QNC share overhang.
insights.locator: Quantum eMotion Corp. (NYSE American: QNC; TSXV: QNC; FSE: 34Q0)

insights.claim: Plurilock shareholders approved the arrangement on November 18, the Supreme Court of British Columbia gave final clearance on November 20, and Plurilock shares are scheduled to delist from the TSX Venture Exchange on or about November 26.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Deal is complete; PLUR ceases trading, removing the arbitrage.

insights.claim: The Quantum eMotion–Plurilock combination pairs quantum-generated entropy and post-quantum cryptography products with Plurilock's established enterprise and public-sector cybersecurity operations (Critical Services, identity and access management, cloud security) and procurement channels across Canada, the US and NATO.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Buying distribution and government channels is a route for small PQC vendors to monetize ahead of mandated PQC migration.
insights.locator: The transaction pairs Quantum eMotion’s quantum-generated entropy
